comment: Round-4 sprint-1 data fixes (items 7 and 8), authored 2026-08-29. Shabbat closures are recorded as closed_days [6] (Saturday) only where the business is a certified-kosher chain or the record's own kosher_status asserts kosher — Israeli kosher certification is not granted to businesses trading on Shabbat. No weekday opening hours are claimed: official chain sites (rami-levy.co.il, super-pharm.co.il, shufersal.co.il) were fetched on 2026-08-29 and returned 403 / a redirect with no branch hours / a maintenance page, so none could be verified. Tiv Taam (BUS-034, record notes it is not kosher and it trades on Shabbat), Carrefour Hyper (BUS-032), La Perle (BUS-037) and every pharmacy are deliberately left unmarked as unverified.
